label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: [name] banner has Agree and continue as the prominent button, and declining needs opening [name] settings, then switching off three separate switches before confirming with the same Agree and continue label, which is misleading.

Many links and carousel slides have no accessible name or a long run-together name (price, colour names, repeated product name), and the main region is named with raw code text t(general.slider.accessibility.productCards).

Size radios could not be jumped to with the elements list and only became reachable by tabbing from Close; tabbing then lands in a radio group with no hint of how many sizes or whether any are sold out.

After Add to cart a newsletter popup opened with no announcement that the item was added; closing it returned me to the size dialog, so I could not tell whether the add worked until I re-read the header cart count.

Checkout showed an error text about a missing snippet and empty iframes at first, and the shipping and payment forms only appeared on a later re-read with no announcement; the payment email and postal code fields sit in an iframe with the heading saying the address should be in [name].
